operations.content:
## findings routes

- `/findings` - combined analyst-style findings
- `/findings/clusters` - readable cluster findings
- `/findings/cluster/:id` - one cluster finding
- `/findings/narratives` - readable narrative findings
- `/findings/narrative/:id` - one narrative finding
